derived_notes.sample_confidence: high >= 34 GP, medium 17-33, low < 17. Always present when a consistency rate is.
derived_notes.trajectory_3yr: Least-squares slope of positional finish rank over the last 3 PLAYED seasons, x = real year. NEGATIVE = improving.
derived_notes.adp_edge: (Average ADP - TrueValue) in picks on the source's 12-team board. POSITIVE = market discount. NOTE the board is 12-team while the league is 10-team, so a 'full round' of drift here is 12 picks, not 10.
derived_notes.td_dependency: TD share minus yardage share, position-appropriate block. Large positive = TD-dependent, i.e. regression exposure.
derived_notes.composite: Deliberately absent. The dimensions stay separate and visible.
